## Backward: what the brain's sources cite

_`2×` means cited in two paragraphs; ◆ names the high-priority cards that lift a work; each list is sorted by score. `priority: high` on a reference card puts it at the top. Recent work comes first: a score halves with every 8 years of age unless the work is foundational, marked ⌛ when it is older than that (cited by two or more sources, in two or more paragraphs where one source's methods or results rest on it, marked high, or carrying `foundational::` or a `cited_count::` of 500 or more). A work foundational only by the counts keeps half its score once older than 16 years, and is listed with the classics._
